binning: encoded sRGB code value, min(floor(v * 256), 255), clamped to [0,1]

drag.control: the same renderer, same fixture, same run, no histogram sample issued
drag.node: ColorRenderNode (exposure + contrast), the group that needs no face

measures.drag: ms/redraw over 60 redraws, with and without a histogram sample
measures.pass: ms for the clear + accumulate dispatch alone, GPU-timed
measures.stall: main-thread ms/redraw to encode+commit, vs the stalling readback

pass.note: includes the commit + waitUntilCompleted round trip, so it is an upper bound on the GPU time
